orderedChain: admit this formal manifest with the production checker and independent review
on later implementation authority, establish managed runner observability before dynamic validation
implement foundation and edge diagnostics with secret-safe red mutations

dependencyAndSerialBoundaries: This design admission precedes all listed implementation surfaces.
Runner remote control and log-read controls precede any long dynamic test.
Foundation diagnostics precede edge integration so no app-local duplicate is introduced.
Root projection validation precedes generated consumer regeneration; generated outputs are never hand edited.
A future package exit must compare independent baseline paths, pre/post receipts and incremental checks by exact set equality.

dataEvolution.notApplicableReason: The formal binding has no persistence, migration, seed or reset behavior; future runner evidence is external diagnostic output and must be separately cleaned up.

uiAndTerms.notApplicableReason: This is a no-UI control-plane design unit; it neither adds nor changes a page, shell, form, wording or interaction.

evidence.l1: Production implementation-design-granularity checker validates manifest identity, source hashes, unique anchors, unit surfaces and review fields.
evidence.l2: Future P6-1 implementation validates OpenAPI root/target projection and public security error mapping through production paths.
evidence.l3: Future package exit proves actual changed paths equal pre/post receipt paths and non-empty incremental checks, with hook canary and source disposition.
evidence.business: Unauthenticated authentication and recovery remain safe, supportable and brand-correct without changing the accepted product behavior.
evidence.cleanup: NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON: no dynamic environment is started by this design-only CP-U11 unit; future managed runs report cleanup separately.

forbiddenPseudoFixes: A prose checklist or relaxed checker in place of the existing production gate.
Treating the former extension cycle as review evidence for this material new scope.
Replacing a source-bound denominator with a static scan, source-string self-test or exit code.
Implementing future runner, foundation, edge, OpenAPI, generated, UI or database bytes during this design-only unit.

discriminator.fixture: The production checker self-test must retain real red fixtures for missing D1 sources, flow-named runtime surfaces, review round overflow and manifest/hash drift; later production-path mutations must prove security terminal, runner and edge-projection controls.
